title: Trident Channeling Enhanced（三叉戟引雷增强 ）
description:
Channeling up to Lv.5 with a chance of non-thunderstorm lightning & chain damage. Adds "Trident Shot" for Crossbows to fire powerful Tridents.

引雷上限至 5 级，支持非雷雨天概率落雷与连锁闪电。新增“海神之引”附魔，使弩能发射高伤三叉戟。
body:
# Description

## Mechanism Changes: Channeling Enchantment

- Level cap increased to 5
- Channeling Level X deals X chains of damage
  - When attacking while holding (the weapon), it deals X-1 hits of damage.
  - Chain radius: (1.75 + Chain Level × 0.25) blocks
  - Chain effect can trigger even without hitting a mob.
- The X-th chain damage is: Base Damage * (1 - (X / Total Chains))
- Base Damage:
  - Held attack: base damage is melee attack damage
  - Throw attack: base damage is 8
  - Loaded into Crossbow attack: base damage mechanism is similar to arrows, but base damage is higher (2.0-->3.0)
    - Note: If a trident fired from a crossbow fails to hit a mob, the base damage is 8.
- Channeling Level X has 2*(X-1)% chance to summon lightning in non-thunder weather

## New Enchantment: Trident Shot

- Effect: Allows Tridents to be loaded into Crossbows
- Acquisition: 10% chance to obtain from Treasure Map Chests

## New Enchantment: Chain Reach

- Effect: Increases the chain detection distance
- Acquisition:
  - Treasure Map Chests: 15% chance to obtain (enchantment level 1-4 randomly assigned)
  - Shipwrecks: 15% chance to obtain (enchantment level 1-5 randomly assigned)

# 简介

## 机制修改：引雷附魔

- 上限增加至5级
- 引雷x级，能造成x段连锁伤害
  - 手持攻击时造成x-1段伤害
  - 连锁半径为（1.75+连锁等级*0.25）格
  - 未击中生物也可连锁
- 第x段伤害为：基础伤害*（1-（x/总段数））
- 基础伤害：
  - 手持攻击，基础伤害为手持攻击伤害
  - 投掷攻击，基础伤害为8
  - 装填至弩上攻击，基础伤害机制与弩箭类似，但基础伤害更高（2.0-->3.0）
    - 注：弩射击的三叉戟若未击中生物，则基础伤害为8
- 引雷x级，在非雷雨天有2*(x-1)%的概率召唤闪电

## 附魔新增：海神之引

- 效果：使三叉戟可以装填至弩上
- 获取方式：藏宝图宝箱有10%概率开出

## 附魔新增：连锁
- 效果：增加连锁的判定距离
- 获取方式：
  - 藏宝图宝箱有15%概率开出（附魔等级1-4随机分配）
  - 沉船有15%概率开出（附魔等级1-5随机分配）
